readme:
# Poshmark Scraper

Collect listings from Poshmark brand and category pages. Each row is one listing with its title, brand, category, price, original price, size, condition, colors, photos, like and comment counts, dates and availability. You pay per listing delivered.

The data comes from the public brand and category pages of [Poshmark](https://poshmark.com/). No account and no API key are needed.

## What you get

For each listing the actor returns one row with:

- `id`, `url`, `title`, `description`: the listing and its page on Poshmark, with the text the seller wrote
- `brand`, `department`, `category`, `subcategory`, `subcategories`: for example Nike, Women, Shoes, Athletic Shoes
- `price`, `originalPrice`, `currency`, `priceDropPercent`: the current price, the original price the seller entered (null when there is none), and the drop shown on the listing
- `size`, `quantityAvailable`, `isMultiItem`: the size text and the units in stock
- `condition` and `conditionCode`: the condition, for example `NWT` (new with tags), with the code as the source gives it
- `colors`, `styleTags`
- `images`: photo addresses
- `likeCount`, `commentCount`, `shareCount`
- `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `firstPublishedAt`: times in UTC
- `availability`, `isAvailable`, `availabilityChangedAt`: `available` or `sold_out`, and when it last changed
- `shippingDiscountType`, `hasShippingDiscount`: the shipping discount shown on the listing
- `dealType`: the deal badge, for example `hot_deal`
- `sellerUsername`, `sellerId`, `sellerClosetUrl`: the seller's public closet username, id and link
- `sourceUrl`, `scrapedAt`

A value the source does not show is null. Lists with nothing in them are empty.

## Typical uses

- Track resale prices of a brand, a category or a size
- Compare asking prices with original prices and price drops
- Follow how fast listings sell, using the sold filter and the dates
- Feed a price tool, a spreadsheet or a catalog with fresh listings

## Pricing

You pay per listing delivered, plus a small fee for each run.

| Event | Name | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Run start (charged once, together with the first delivered row) | `actor-start` | $0.001 per run |
| One listing row | `listing-result` | $0.001 per listing ($1.00 per 1,000) |

A run that finds nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost for the run, the actor stops cleanly once the next row would go over it.

**New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough for a first test run before you pay anything.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `startUrls` | list | empty | Poshmark brand or category pages, for example `https://poshmark.com/brand/Nike-Women-Shoes` or `https://poshmark.com/category/Women-Shoes` |
| `brands` | list | empty | Brand names such as `Nike` or `Free People`. Combined with `department` and `category` |
| `department` | text | `Women` | Department such as `Women`, `Men`, `Kids` |
| `category` | text | `Shoes` | Category such as `Shoes`, `Dresses`, `Bags` |
| `sort` | choice | default order | `relevance`, `newest`, `price_asc` or `price_desc` |
| `condition` | choice | all | `all`, `nwt` (new with tags) or `not_nwt` |
| `availability` | choice | `available` | `available` for listings for sale, `sold_out` for sold listings |
| `sizes` | list | empty | Keep only these sizes, for example `8` or `M` |
| `maxItems` | number | 100 | Maximum listings in total, up to 10,000 |

How it works:

- Give `startUrls`, or give `brands` with a department and a category, or give only a department and a category. With no brand the actor reads the category page.
- The actor reads one list page at a time. Each page holds up to 48 listings.
- With several lists, the actor reads one page of each in turn, so a small `maxItems` still covers every list.
- Listings are removed when they appear twice, for example when a page shifts while new items arrive.
- Options such as `sort` and `sizes` apply to every list and replace the same option inside a pasted address.
- Number fields also accept numbers written as text, for example `"50"`.
- Started with no input, the actor returns a sample of Women Shoes listings.

### Example: Nike women's shoes

```json
{
  "brands": ["Nike"],
  "department": "Women",
  "category": "Shoes",
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: sold listings of a category, newest first

```json
{
  "startUrls": [{ "url": "https://poshmark.com/category/Women-Shoes" }],
  "availability": "sold_out",
  "sort": "newest",
  "maxItems": 200
}
```

## Limitations

- Rows include the seller's public closet username, id and closet link, as shown on every listing card. They do not include avatars, names or other profile data.
- The actor reads brand and category pages only. It does not read search results, seller closets or single listing pages.
- Poshmark lets a single list page be read up to about 5,000 listings deep. For more, split the work by brand, size or condition.
- Page order changes while new listings arrive, so a few listings can be missed between two pages. Sorting by `newest` keeps the order steadiest.
- The label for `condition` is our reading of the code (`nwt` is NWT, `uln` is Like new, `ug` is Good, `uf` is Fair, `not_nwt` is Not NWT). The code is also in `conditionCode`. Many listings have no condition.
- `originalPrice` is what the seller typed, and is null when the seller left it empty.
- `likeCount`, `commentCount` and prices change often. A row shows the values at `scrapedAt`.
- There is no price filter. Use `sort` and the `price` field instead.
- If the source keeps refusing, the run stops with a status that says so, and only delivered rows are charged.

## FAQ

**Do I need a Poshmark account?**
No. The actor reads public pages.

**How do I get a brand address?**
Open the brand on Poshmark, choose a department and a category, and copy the address. It looks like `https://poshmark.com/brand/Nike-Women-Shoes`. Or type the brand name in `brands`.

**Why did I get fewer rows than `maxItems`?**
The brand, category and filters hold fewer listings, or the maximum cost you set for the run was reached. The run status message says which.

**What happens with a brand that does not exist?**
The run ends with no rows, nothing is charged, and the status says that no page exists at that address.

**Can one listing show up twice?**
No. Rows are unique by listing id within a run.

**Can a run be restarted safely?**
Yes. Progress is saved after every page. A restarted run continues where it stopped and does not deliver or charge the same rows twice.

**Is this affiliated with Poshmark?**
No. This is an independent tool that reads public data. Please keep your use modest and in line with the terms of the source.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=nanodata/poshmark-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `poshmark-scraper` to list 30 Nike women's sneakers on Poshmark with price, size and condition. Return results as a table."

Found a problem or need a field added? Open an issue on the [Issues tab](https://apify.com/nanodata/poshmark-scraper/issues). We usually reply within one business day. You can also email contact@nanoscrape.com.
